name: hh-meanrev-micro: washout fade, spike-not-slide range-position gate (5m)
rationale: MECHANISM: the reliable liquidation snapback comes from a SPIKE (one violent bar into a thin book), not a SLIDE (an orderly grind lower that is correctly-priced bad news). This variant gates the washout fade on range_position — requiring price to sit at the extreme LOW of its recent range (a genuine spike to the bottom) rather than mid-range drift — so we only fade dislocations where the price-insensitive seller has overshot and left an air pocket the maker refills. Entry: bb_z multi-sigma washout AND rsi oversold AND range_position below a fitted floor (pinned at the bottom of the range = spike). Long-only spot; exit on bb_z reversion. DISCONFIRMER: if the range_position gate does not improve net-of-fee win-rate versus the plain washout fade, a spike and a slide are indistinguishable here and the gate is curve-fit — kill. If performance flips sign when the range_position floor is nudged 10-20%, the gate is a fitted artifact, not a real spike/slide separation.
catalyst: washout pinned to the range low (spike) rather than an orderly slide
